Thanks again for your continued engagement with FinSecure's RFP. Our security and operations team is consolidating responses for Section B (Operational Readiness). Could you please provide the following by EOD Friday, Apr 9: 

- A simple operational contacts list (named TAM, backup TAM, escalation leads) with role, email, and phone number.
- Your TAM coverage model (hours, SLAs, whether TAM is dedicated or shared).
- On‑call rotation and escalation path for Sev1/Sev2 incidents (who is notified and escalation timing).
- Incident communication cadence and sample templates (ack, initial update, mitigation updates, postmortem).
- Any audit log/retention commitments and where audit evidence lives.

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear ask and the deadline. We can deliver a completed Section B set and supporting artifacts by Apr 8 (one day earlier) unless you prefer Apr 9. Quick clarifications so our answers are scoped correctly: 

1) Scope: confirm you want production-only (no dev/staging) — you mentioned production in the note but want to be explicit.
2) Audit logs: do you have a minimum retention window you need referenced in the RFP (e.g., 12/13/24 months)? We will provide our standard retention and optional extended retention add-on.
3) Is a named dedicated TAM required at contract signature, or is a shared TAM model acceptable initially? We can propose both options.

I will loop Marissa (CS Ops lead) and Ben (TAM ops) to assemble the TAM coverage grid, on‑call rotation example, escalation matrix, and incident templates. Expect attachments (grid + incident templates + short narrative).

If you prefer a 30-minute review next week, I can offer Apr 11 at 10:00 AM PT.

Thanks — Neha

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft: Section B responses, TAM coverage grid, and incident journey (for review)

Neha / Ben — attaching a draft package for review before we send to Laura. I've tried to keep answers concise to match FinSecure's template. Key points up front: 

- TAM coverage: default offering is a named primary TAM during business hours (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm local) + shared on‑call rotation for 24x7 Sev1 coverage. Option for a dedicated 24x7 TAM (paid add-on) at contract.
- On‑call & escalation: Level 1 (TAM or on‑call engineer) ack within 15 minutes for Sev1; Level 2 escalation to Senior Oncall/Infra in 30–60 minutes depending on severity. Escalation matrix included in the grid.
- SLA/uptime: Hosted API SLA target 99.95% for production endpoints; we include a credit schedule in dedicated contracts.
- Incident comms: immediate ack (within 15 minutes), initial assessment update within 60 minutes, hourly status during active mitigation, and a triaged postmortem within 72 hours (full RCA within 10 business days for Sev1). Templates attached.
- Audit logs: standard retention 13 months in our control plane; we can extend to 24/36 months as a managed retention add‑on. Evidence for SOC2/ISO is provided via our secure doc portal link.

Attached: Redwood_Operational_Answers_20270405.docx (narrative), TAM_Coverage_Grid_v2.xlsx (matrix), Incident_Comm_Template.docx (email templates + cadence). Please review draft wording — I left placeholders for specific phone numbers and legal phrasing that Ben should confirm.

Tom / Laura — great questions. Quick answers: 

1) On‑call schedule: attaching a one‑week sample rotation (included in TAM_Coverage_Grid_v2.xlsx, tab: sample_schedule). The standard pattern is 7‑day shifts for the infra on‑call with weekday primary TAM coverage and a rotating weekend on‑call pool. Shift handoffs documented in the runbook.

2) Named TAM response times: named TAMs operate on business‑hours SLAs (Mon–Fri 9–6 local) for proactive account work and triage; for Sev1 incidents the dedicated on‑call engineering rotation (24x7) is the primary responder and the named TAM coordinates communications and post‑incident follow‑up. We can offer a dedicated 24x7 named TAM commit as a contractual add‑on with corresponding service credits.

If you want to review verbally, I can set a 20‑minute call for Apr 7 at 09:30 AM PT — accepting if that works for you.
